limits: One local replica-set member and two clients. The run does not cover failover or multinode behavior.
Manifest pages and the final source read each have their own snapshots. The old-snapshot case returns an observation before a fresh read rejects the removal.
Objects and source bytes are synthetic. Coverage of remote writers, retention, physical copy authorization and ownership commit remain pending.
The final session error is injected at the application boundary after real session close.
